text: Everything in Lessons 14 and 15 described one shape of Discovery, scanning a range and populating whatever it finds. There's a second, very different shape, and the real distinction between the two matters for how a CMDB program actually plans its scanning rather than just running the same kind of scan everywhere.

Horizontal Discovery is the broad sweep — scanning across many infrastructure types at once, servers, network devices, databases, to build general CMDB coverage. It doesn't trace any one application's dependencies going in; it's finding and classifying whatever exists in a range, the way Lessons 14 and 15 described. Vertical Discovery does the opposite: it goes deep on one specific application or service, tracing its full dependency chain rather than scanning broadly, and it's closely related to the Service Mapping capability from Chapter 2.

Vertical Discovery asks a different question than a broad sweep does. Instead of "what infrastructure exists in this subnet," it asks "this one critical application — what does it actually depend on, end to end, to function?" That might mean tracing from a web server to its load balancer, to its application server, to its database, to the storage array underneath that database — a precise chain for one service, not a flat inventory of whatever else happens to be nearby.

Both exist because they solve genuinely different problems. A program running only Horizontal Discovery knows what infrastructure exists broadly but has no reliable dependency map for any specific critical service — exactly the gap that matters most the moment that service goes down and someone needs to know what to check first. A program running only Vertical Discovery has excellent dependency maps for a handful of important applications but no general awareness of everything else actually running in the environment.

Horizontal Discovery for broad baseline coverage across an environment, Vertical Discovery for a precise dependency map of one business-critical service. Next: what it actually takes to run either kind of Discovery at all, starting with the MID Server requirement this whole chapter has been assuming.
